svg.title: Pi Desktop — 18-screen streamline design study
svg.desc: Proposed designs, not app screenshots. Eighteen vector screens covering the main views, dialogs, search states and compact layouts.
svg.text: PI DESKTOP · DESIGN STUDY · 1 OCTOBER 2026 · PROPOSALS, NOT IMPLEMENTED UI
A quieter workbench — the whole app.
18 vector screens · warm surfaces · legible text · one task per pane · no added title-bar clutter
Zoom to inspect. Click a screen title for its individual SVG. Rationale and 26 actual Xvfb captures: visual-review-2026-10-01/README.md

svg.title: Pi Desktop — proposed design, not an app screenshot
svg.text: qwen3.8-flash on OpenCode returns empty thinking signatures and we reject the response.
Accept empty signatures there, but keep the check strict for Anthropic.
The check lives in openai-completions.ts. I’ll allow empty strings for OpenCode
and leave the Anthropic path untouched.

g.text: Also add a regression test for the OpenCode path
Run the qwen provider tests once check passes

svg.text: User resources · reported by the selected session
Project trust is not an OS sandbox.

g.text: Consistent scope, tabs and resource title; one place for intentional package actions.

svg.title: Pi Desktop — proposed design, not an app screenshot
svg.text: Trust this folder only if you are comfortable running its extensions and settings.
Context files may still load without project trust.
Saved trust and the running process can differ. Trust is not a security sandbox.
No project extensions, skills or prompts reported in this process.
Project · not trusted in this process
Project code can run with your permissions.
it does not unload code already running.

g.text: One trust entry point with consequences visible; trust is not a sandbox.

svg.title: Pi Desktop — proposed design, not an app screenshot
svg.text: Defaults for new sessions. Running sessions keep their current settings.
Choose the model new sessions start with.
More thinking can improve answers and increase cost.
Models available when cycling in a session.
Hide reasoning text in the conversation.
Show a notice when a request misses the prompt cache.

g.text: Inline explanations. JSON keys and advanced settings remain available on demand.

svg.title: Pi Desktop — proposed design, not an app screenshot
svg.text: A warm page by day. A quiet workbench at night.
System follows your operating system’s appearance.
Ctrl+Shift+T temporarily switches themes until the next launch.
Pi Desktop preferences · never read by the agent

g.text: Theme previews convey a real choice; do not add a dashboard of new settings.
